title: Appearance
colorsDescription: Override individual roles of the wallpaper-generated theme. Each palette keeps its own set, so dark and light can differ.
editingInactive: Editing the inactive palette - changes apply when you switch to %1 mode.
scopeWallpaperDescription: Colors are tied to the current wallpaper - switching wallpapers switches to whatever was saved for it.
scopeGlobalDescription: One color set applies everywhere, no matter which wallpaper is active.
themesDescription: Save the colors and wallpaper currently in effect under a name, then re-apply them later. Pin a theme (and give it a wallpaper) to add it to the quick theme switcher.
pinnedNoWallpaperHint: This theme has no wallpaper attached, so it won't show up in the quick theme switcher even while pinned.
